scope: isolated synthetic 1000-loop standard-hourly KPI only; no production claims
accounting: Sum all cgroup memory.current charges for the three containers plus host API/master/every pool/Beat PID RSS. Includes cgroup page cache; no container PID duplicate; anon/shmem reported but never added again. Conservative upper bound, not exact physical RSS.
events: Any OOM, resource exhaustion, connection exhaustion, duplicate master/Beat, missing required identity or sampling gap is a failure or explicit manual REWORK/BLOCKED, never silently PASS.
limits: TD process query cache reset only; host/Docker VM page cache not controlled; TD supported pool0 is explicit test configuration, does not demonstrate default pool1 or production capacity; G5-D04 other modalities remain outside this KPI series.
